options: __init__, __repr__ and __eq__, from the list of fields
Type checks that run while the program runs
questions.explain: You list fields like name: str; @dataclass writes the boring methods. You still write your own rules (e.g. in __post_init__).

questions.q: In a dataclass, how do you give every Cart its own empty list?
questions.explain: default_factory calls list() for each new object. A plain = [] is refused: 'mutable default ... use default_factory'.

questions.q: def line_total(price_paise: int, quantity: int) -> int. You call line_total("299", 2) and run it with python3. What happens?
options: It returns '299299': Python ignores hints while running
questions.explain: Hints are only notes. Python runs "299" * 2, which repeats the text. mypy would have caught it before running.

options: Reads the code and its type hints and reports type mistakes, without running anything
questions.explain: mypy examples/type_hints.py reported: Argument 1 to "line_total" has incompatible type "str"; expected "int".

questions.q: Where do you put a check like 'price must be above 0' in a dataclass?
options: In __post_init__, which runs right after the generated __init__
questions.explain: __post_init__ is the place for your own checks; it can raise ValueError for bad data.

questions.q: Why make the DIWALI150 Coupon a frozen dataclass?
options: So nobody can change its discount after it's made: assigning raises FrozenInstanceError
Frozen objects are saved to disk
So it can have no fields
questions.explain: Frozen objects are safe to share: nothing can change them behind your back. Make a new object instead.

questions.q: (Going deeper) What does the hint -> Product | None mean?
options: The function returns a Product, or None (for example when nothing was found)
questions.explain: | means 'or'. mypy then reminds callers to handle the None case.

questions.q: (Going deeper) Hints + mypy check your code. What checks data that arrives from a form or an API while running?
options: Run-time checks: your own __post_init__, or libraries like pydantic / DRF serializers that read the hints
questions.explain: Outside data only exists while running, so it needs a run-time check. Bazaar's API will use DRF serializers for this.
